description: Fix the Duo Screen pane-launch failure (startActivityAsUser -> -91 / aInfo is null) by resolving the launcher ComponentName in-app under the already-held QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES and launching the explicit component, and by guarding against the app launching its own package (dev.autobridge) into a pane — which is the concrete target that produced the -91 in the live capture. Keep the implicit-intent path as a fallback so already-working apps cannot regress. Verify the launch on-device via logcat, least-invasive first; if MIUI still cancels the cross-display launch after explicit resolution, capture and classify the exact rejection line (resolution vs trusted-display/display-owner boundary). The shell-UID launch mechanics are unchanged; only the intent's component and the pane picker/launch guards change. No change touches the safe/Play flavor or the main manifest.
steps: Read context.json and this file FIRST; context.json replaces re-exploration. Then read DuoScreenShizukuOps.kt, DuoScreenPrivilegedOps.kt, DuoScreenController.kt, DuoScreenStore.kt, DuoScreenSettingsActivity.kt, DuoScreenScreen.kt, DuoScreenSpikeActivity.kt in app/src/duoscreen/java/dev/autobridge/duoscreen/ fully before editing.

Create app/src/duoscreen/java/dev/autobridge/duoscreen/DuoScreenLauncherResolver.kt: object with `data class LauncherActivity(val packageName: String, val activityName: String)` and `fun explicitComponentOrNull(packageName: String, candidates: List<LauncherActivity>): ComponentName?` returning the first candidate whose packageName matches (preserving order), as a ComponentName, else null. No framework calls inside — plain data in, JVM-testable like DuoScreenLayoutCodec.

In DuoScreenPrivilegedOps.kt add `component: android.content.ComponentName? = null` to launchOnDisplay. In DuoScreenShizukuOps.kt launchOnDisplay: when component != null build the intent with .setComponent(component) (still ACTION_MAIN + CATEGORY_LAUNCHER + FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK); when null keep the existing implicit setPackage(packageName) fallback. Leave buildStartActivityArgs, the shell-UID startActivityAsUser call, and result handling unchanged. Update the stale 'deliberately unresolved to avoid QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES' comment to state resolution is now done in-app under the permission the personal/lab manifest already declares, implicit intent kept only as fallback.

In DuoScreenController.kt add a private helper resolveLauncherComponent(packageName): ComponentName? that calls context.packageManager.queryIntentActivities(Intent(ACTION_MAIN).addCategory(CATEGORY_LAUNCHER).setPackage(packageName), 0) using the SDK 33+ PackageManager.ResolveInfoFlags.of(0L) form with a @Suppress("DEPRECATION") pre-33 fallback (match InstalledAppRepository.queryLaunchableActivities in src/main), maps ResolveInfo.activityInfo to DuoScreenLauncherResolver.LauncherActivity, and returns DuoScreenLauncherResolver.explicitComponentOrNull(packageName, candidates). Call it in both openPane and reload, passing the result to ops.launchOnDisplay(displayId, packageName, component).

In DuoScreenController.openPane and reload: guard self-launch — if packageName == context.packageName (the app's own package dev.autobridge) skip the launch and StructuredLog.w a clear reason (self-launch is never a valid pane target and is the -91 cause). When resolveLauncherComponent returns null for any other package, StructuredLog.w naming the package, then still call launchOnDisplay with component = null so the implicit fallback runs. Keep the existing '= $launched' success log and include whether an explicit component was used.

In DuoScreenSettingsActivity.pickAppFor filter out packageName == this.packageName from the launchable list so AutoBridge itself can no longer be chosen as a pane app (prevents re-storing the dev.autobridge self-target).

Create app/src/duoscreen/test/dev/autobridge/duoscreen/DuoScreenLauncherResolverTest.kt (plain JUnit like DuoScreenPaneSetTest, in src/duoscreen/test wired into testPersonal). Cover: single matching candidate -> explicit component with that activity name; multiple candidates same package -> first (best-match order preserved); candidates for a different package only -> null; empty list -> null. If ComponentName throws 'not mocked' under JVM tests despite isReturnDefaultValues, switch the resolver to return the matched LauncherActivity and build the ComponentName at the call site, asserting on packageName/activityName instead.
JVM gate: run ./gradlew :app:assemblePersonalDebug then ./gradlew :app:testPersonalDebugUnitTest and confirm both pass.

On-device launch verification: ./gradlew :app:installPersonalDebug. First confirm the dev.autobridge origin — adb -s YXEMRCGYAI49S4SS shell run-as dev.autobridge cat /data/data/dev.autobridge/shared_prefs/autobridge_duo_screen.xml (or inspect via the Duo Screen settings screen) and record whether a pane's stored package was dev.autobridge. Re-pick valid pane apps (e.g. com.miui.calculator, com.android.settings) via the settings screen now that the picker excludes self. Then adb -s YXEMRCGYAI49S4SS logcat -c, launch the session (DHU/car surface, or the harness: adb -s YXEMRCGYAI49S4SS shell am start -n dev.autobridge/.duoscreen.DuoScreenSpikeActivity --es packages com.miui.calculator,com.android.settings), then adb -s YXEMRCGYAI49S4SS logcat -d -s AutoBridgeDuoOps:* ActivityTaskManager:* ActivityStarterImpl:* XSpaceManagerServiceImpl:*. Record the exact log lines.

If the launch still returns -91 / aInfo is null after explicit-component resolution, re-run the capture and record the exact rejection line; classify whether it is now the trusted-display/display-owner boundary (ROADMAP.md 'Own-content and privileged display — PARTIAL/BLOCKED') rather than intent resolution, and document which precisely.

Record the launch outcome (FIXED with the real-package success line, or PLATFORM-BLOCKED with the exact failing line and the boundary it hits) in findings for FEAT-002 and the final report. Set this feature's status to completed. Commit nothing.
acceptance_criteria: ./gradlew :app:testPersonalDebugUnitTest passes, including the new DuoScreenLauncherResolverTest and all existing duoscreen tests (DuoScreenLayoutCodecTest, DuoScreenPaneSetTest, DuoScreenInputRouterTest, DuoScreenResizeDebouncerTest, DuoScreenThreadSlotTest, DuoScreenLayoutTest).

launchOnDisplay sets an explicit ComponentName when the in-app resolver finds one, and both openPane and reload pass a resolved component; the app's own package is never launched into a pane (self-launch guard present, picker excludes self).

On-device, with a valid pane app selected, the launch no longer returns -91 with 'aInfo is null': logcat shows startActivityAsUser(<real pkg> -> display N) with result >= 0 and the pane app runs — OR, if it still fails, the exact rejection log line is captured and classified as the trusted-display/display-owner platform boundary (a valid fix-or-prove-unfixable outcome).
No change to the safe/Play flavor, the main manifest, or the shell-UID launch mechanics; nothing is committed.
verification: ./gradlew :app:installPersonalDebug then: adb -s YXEMRCGYAI49S4SS logcat -c; reproduce the pane launch; adb -s YXEMRCGYAI49S4SS logcat -d -s AutoBridgeDuoOps:* ActivityTaskManager:* ActivityStarterImpl:* XSpaceManagerServiceImpl:* — confirm no -91/aInfo-is-null for a valid package, or capture+classify the rejection line
findings:
VERDICT: FIXED. The pane launch now succeeds on-device YXEMRCGYAI49S4SS (23078PND5G, Android 16/MIUI) with no -91 / no 'aInfo is null'.

JVM GATE: PASSED. ./gradlew :app:assemblePersonalDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL. ./gradlew :app:testPersonalDebugUnitTest BUILD SUCCESSFUL (forced with --rerun-tasks). New DuoScreenLauncherResolverTest: 4/4 pass. All existing duoscreen tests green: DuoScreenInputRouterTest 11/0, DuoScreenLayoutCodecTest 8/0, DuoScreenLayoutTest 14/0, DuoScreenPaneSetTest 6/0, DuoScreenResizeDebouncerTest 7/0, DuoScreenThreadSlotTest 4/0 (tests/failures).

SELF-TARGET ORIGIN CONFIRMED: /data/data/dev.autobridge/shared_prefs/autobridge_duo_screen.xml stored layout had pane 0 pkg = "dev.autobridge" (the app's own package), pane 1 = com.google.android.apps.maps. This dev.autobridge self-target is the concrete package that produced the original -91/aInfo-is-null.

ON-DEVICE RUN 1 (restored layout exercising the live self-target, harness DuoScreenSpikeActivity): the self-launch guard fired and the valid app launched explicitly. Exact lines:
  W AutoBridgeDuoCtl: Pane 0: refusing to launch own package dev.autobridge into a pane (self-launch is never a valid pane target and is the -91/aInfo-is-null cause)
  I ActivityTaskManager: START u0 {act=android.intent.action.MAIN cat=[android.intent.category.LAUNCHER] flg=0x10000000 cmp=com.google.android.apps.maps/com.google.android.maps.MapsActivity} with LAUNCH_SINGLE_TASK from uid 2000 from pid 6681 callingPackage com.android.shell (BAL_ALLOW_PERMISSION) result code=0
  I AutoBridgeDuoCtl: Pane 1: launch(com.google.android.apps.maps on display 2946) = true (explicit ComponentInfo{com.google.android.apps.maps/com.google.android.maps.MapsActivity})
  I ActivityTaskManager: Displayed com.google.android.apps.maps/com.google.android.maps.MapsActivity for user 0: +478ms / Fully drawn +632ms
No -91 and no 'aInfo is null' anywhere in the capture; the guard replaced the previous reject.

ON-DEVICE RUN 2 (cleared layout, two valid apps via --es packages com.miui.calculator,com.android.settings): both panes launched explicitly and were displayed. Exact lines:
  I AutoBridgeDuoCtl: Pane 0: launch(com.miui.calculator on display 2953) = true (explicit ComponentInfo{com.miui.calculator/com.miui.calculator.cal.CalculatorActivity})
  I ActivityTaskManager: START u0 {act=android.intent.action.MAIN cat=[android.intent.category.LAUNCHER] flg=0x10000000 cmp=com.miui.calculator/.cal.CalculatorActivity} with LAUNCH_SINGLE_TOP from uid 2000 ... callingPackage com.android.shell (BAL_ALLOW_PERMISSION) result code=0
  I ActivityTaskManager: Displayed com.miui.calculator/.cal.CalculatorActivity for user 0: +1s96ms
  I AutoBridgeDuoCtl: Pane 1: launch(com.android.settings on display 2954) = true (explicit ComponentInfo{com.android.settings/com.android.settings.MainSettings})
  I ActivityTaskManager: START u0 {act=android.intent.action.MAIN cat=[android.intent.category.LAUNCHER] flg=0x10000000 cmp=com.android.settings/.MainSettings} with LAUNCH_MULTIPLE from uid 2000 ... callingPackage com.android.shell (BAL_ALLOW_PERMISSION) result code=0
  I ActivityTaskManager: Displayed com.android.settings/.MainSettings for user 0: +1s486ms
Both launches resolved via the in-app explicit ComponentName (not the implicit fallback) and landed on their own-content pane displays (2953, 2954) with result code=0. No -91, no aInfo-null, no trusted-display/display-owner rejection on the LAUNCH path.

CLASSIFICATION: The original -91/aInfo-is-null was NOT a platform display-owner boundary — it was (a) the app launching its own package (dev.autobridge) into a pane and (b) the implicit MAIN/LAUNCHER+setPackage intent failing to resolve shell-side on MIUI. Both are fixed in-app: explicit ComponentName resolution under QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES + a self-launch guard + the picker now excluding self. XSpaceManagerServiceImpl checkXSpaceControl (from com.android.shell -> target) passed for every launch. The cross-display TOUCH/raw-input landing on the UNTRUSTED own-content VirtualDisplay remains the separate boundary for FEAT-002 to verify — launch is proven working here; touch was not exercised in this step.

CODE STATE (FEAT-001, nothing committed): DuoScreenLauncherResolver.kt (returns LauncherActivity to stay JVM-testable), DuoScreenLauncherResolverTest.kt, the component param on DuoScreenPrivilegedOps.launchOnDisplay, the explicit/implicit branch in DuoScreenShizukuOps.launchOnDisplay, and DuoScreenController.resolveLauncherComponent were already present; this step added the self-launch guard in DuoScreenController.openPane and reload (packageName == context.packageName -> StructuredLog.w + skip) and the self-exclusion filter in DuoScreenSettingsActivity.pickAppFor (filter { it != packageName }). No change to safe/Play flavor, main manifest, or shell-UID launch mechanics.
